subject.title: [Bug]: qqbot + ollama + local model: qwen3.5:27b report: error Embedded agent failed before reply: LLM request failed: network connection was interrupted

question: For silent active local-model calls in QQBot sessions, should diagnostics recovery be allowed to abort before the configured provider timeout, or should it inherit/derive from that timeout?
rationale: Both behaviors are defensible: early recovery protects queues from wedged runs, while the reporter's existing provider timeout setting implies long silent Ollama/Qwen calls should be allowed to finish.

options.title: Align Recovery With Provider Timeout
options.body: Derive the active model-call abort threshold from the routed provider timeout for this path, keep warning diagnostics, and require focused recovery plus live QQBot/Ollama proof.

options.title: Keep Separate Diagnostics Policy
options.body: Keep `diagnostics.stuckSessionAbortMs` independent of provider timeout and improve status/doctor/docs so operators know which threshold controls silent local-model recovery.

options.title: Defer Until Live Repro
options.body: Hold code changes until a redacted current-main QQBot/Ollama run identifies whether the cutoff is OpenClaw recovery, provider transport, or host resource pressure.

recommendation.title: Align Recovery With Provider Timeout
recommendation.body: Derive the active model-call abort threshold from the routed provider timeout for this path, keep warning diagnostics, and require focused recovery plus live QQBot/Ollama proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest shared routing candidate across the diagnostics threshold policy and the recent QQBot dispatch surface.
